# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. All results are read from code. Your `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay out of the whole site, and the pages are built in the browser, so crawlers that don't run JavaScript see an empty page. The only unknown is the canonical link (GEO-015), because the code doesn't declare your site's domain. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking all crawlers in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every search and AI-search crawler not to read any page, so nothing else on the site can be found. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59 (fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014). Change it to `Allow: /` and add an absolute `Sitemap:` line. I'm assuming you want to be found. If this block is deliberate, say so and the item changes. ### 2. Put page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** Many crawlers don't run JavaScript. They see only the empty `
`, and the Catalogue list loads only after the page runs in the browser. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large (prerender or server-render the routes) - **Score after this:** 37–46 on its own, from GEO-003 earning its full 3 points. Combined with item 1: 63–72. ### 3. Give each page a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Every page currently shares the title "Vite App", with no description and no language, so machines can't tell the pages apart. - **Where:** `index.html:2` and `index.html:5` - **What the code says:** `` and `Vite App` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 33–41 on its own. Add `lang="en"`, and set a unique title and description per route. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and within size limits | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` (blocks all crawlers, site-wide) | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks Googlebot and Bingbot on `/` and `/catalogue` | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on your own domain | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical in `index.html`, and no domain declared | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8`, and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` (both routes) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is linked from robots.txt | Problem | Not run | No sitemap file or generator, and no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2` (no lang), `index.html:5` (shared title), no description | | GEO-016 | Routes reachable through real links | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11` | | GEO-017 | No snippet blocking | Clear | Not run | Read `index.html` and `src/main.jsx`; there is no `nosnippet` and no headers code | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` (Home fails, Catalogue passes) | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | No `llms.txt` file (unscored) | ## Other problems found - **Catalogue link is a button, not a link.** `src/main.jsx:11`: ``. Use ``. This is the same problem as GEO-016 above. ## Worth considering - **Describe the mugs in text:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` Visitors will likely want to know about prices, sizes, materials and shipping. The code gives them only this one sentence, and the Catalogue shows just names from `/api/mugs`. Adding those facts as text might help readers and machines. - **Give each mug its own page:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. Each item is plain text with no link, so a mug can't be found or shared individually. A page per mug, linked from the list, might help. Product structured data (JSON-LD) could then label price and availability. - **Add a viewport tag:** `index.html:4`: ``. There is no `viewport` tag, which affects how mobile devices read the page. - **Set social tags on shareable pages:** `index.html:5`: `Vite App`. Open Graph tags (the previews shown when a link is shared) might help the home page when it's shared. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** the code doesn't declare your domain. Tell me the domain and I can recheck it. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **`/api/mugs` content:** it is built at runtime, so I can't see what the catalogue holds. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. If the `Disallow: /` is intentional, GEO-009 and GEO-014 would not apply, and the score would change. - I read `/` and `/catalogue`, the only two routes. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
